objective: Verify the owner can upload and enable the Peanuts Skill from an iPad Claude account.
scenario: The owner has an iPad but no laptop. The assistant cannot inspect the owner account or operate Claude settings. A successful local ZIP build does not prove the custom-Skills UI is available or that upload succeeds.

input.runtime_target: Claude iPad app or claude.ai in Safari

expected_behaviors: Check code execution and file-creation capability in the account settings.
Use the current Customize > Skills upload route where available.
Record whether the Skill appears and is enabled.
Mark the owner-side upload and activation NOT RUN until observed by the owner.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim upload/activation passed from local package validation.
Require a laptop or Claude Code for the ordinary Claude chat route.
